question: Does frontend delivery or SMT contention constrain the actual accepted prover enough to justify restructuring its large generated arithmetic callers? Existing cycle-IP, load/retirement and IBS operation profiles do not answer frontend dispatch-slot attribution.
implementation: Use the exact accepted SDK executable with its existing acknowledged perf control, no rebuild or candidate. Linux Zen5 source-defined raw events in three nonmultiplexed four-event panels: frontend/backend/SMT slots; retired/dispatched ops and instructions; frontend-latency condition plus instruction-cache fills. No affected0x18e events. Counter definitions and pipeline metric source bytes pinned.
availability: Run each panel around a small owned CPU task before any SDK capture. All four counts must be supported, cycles positive and enabled/running ratio>=0.99. If unavailable stop before proving and retain negative receipts; no adaptive event substitution.

capture.order: Rotate nine panel/case tuples by block; reverse oddblocks
capture.warm_control: perf stat --delay=-1 --control FIFO; enable acknowledged after loading and3primes, disable acknowledged before export. Exact generic SDK includes fresh randomness, proof, verification, serialization.
capture.concurrency: One owned capture at a time; no owned build/profile/archive overlap; all Gnark export verification after all captures.

validation: All SDK samples, rounds/workers/priming counters and proof length164/publicfixturebinding/freshness required. Every exported proof independently Gnark verified. Pins include accepted170sources/SDK/libraries, exact9eventdefinitions, tables, tool/kernel/PMU format metadata, two images/fixtures/keys/verifier. Verify group running percentages and same-panel ratios; retain every failed or unsupported event.
analysis: Normalize unused dispatch slots and retired macroops against8*usercycles as Linux Zen5 pipeline expressions specify; report each panel separately. Infer frontend-bandwidth component only by subtracting separately captured frontend-latency ratio descriptively, never exact matched-run decomposition. SMT/user-cycle totals aggregate thread observations, not physical-core occupancy or wall-time bounds. Cache fills are lines/1kretiredinstructions only if same-panel instructions exist; otherwise lines/usercycle. No exclusive bottleneck, stalled-wall-time or speed prediction from ratios alone.
scope: Diagnostic primary andmerge54 only; not latency qualification, Aeglos orAWS comparison, no portable/mobile/memory claim. Other supplied-shape accepted CPU/Metal comparisons remain unchanged. Source unchanged and10xgoal unmet.
